mutual_exclusion: exclusive with key tile refill and key scan on same bank unless ping-ponged

note: Streams key xyz tiles from DRAM into distance engine front-end

role: shared distance vector buffer for FPS/KNN
physical_sharing: shared physical SRAM reused by FPS and KNN
mutual_exclusion: FPS and KNN are mutually exclusive in one GAM stage; sorter read vs writer must serialize if same bank
note: Physical SRAM shared, but FPS uses extra min-distance table and KNN consumes current distance vector directly

mutual_exclusion: exclusive with FPS update and FPS sorter read on same region
pipeline_behavior: updated every sampled-center iteration; can ping-pong with dist_sram in future

physical_sharing: shared by FPS/KNN streaming sorters over time
mutual_exclusion: exclusive between FPS and KNN sorter cache use
pipeline_behavior: inactive in base_v1; active in base_v2/acc streaming sort
note: Stores previous batch top candidates before merge with next batch

physical_sharing: shared over time by FPS/KNN acc distance frontend
mutual_exclusion: exclusive with self-distance refill/read on same SRAM region
pipeline_behavior: acc only; stores k^2/self-distance terms before cross-term accumulation
note: Filled after SRAM-CIM self-square pass and read back during cross-term accumulation

role: acc FPS temporary max and speculative-radii SRAM
physical_sharing: shared over time by coarse/fine FPS filtering and speculative radii prediction
mutual_exclusion: exclusive between coarse-filter write, fine-filter consume, resampler, and predictor read/write on the same SRAM
pipeline_behavior: acc only; stores per-batch FPS max candidates and reuses the same SRAM for exact-prefix/predicted radii curve staging
note: Covers both FPS temporary max candidates and speculative radii curve storage

physical_sharing: shared over time by coarse/fine KNN filtering
mutual_exclusion: exclusive between coarse-filter writes and iterative threshold refinement reads
pipeline_behavior: acc only; candidate set iteratively shrinks until fine-filter bandwidth condition is met
note: Stores KNN candidate distances/indices after coarse filter

physical_sharing: shared across nonlinear ops when lifetimes do not overlap
mutual_exclusion: exclusive across ops within the same layer execution window
pipeline_behavior: can be partitioned later into GAM/LFP/GFP workspaces; chunkable for feature pipeline
note: Current contract still exports finer names such as spool_workspace_sram and kan_workspace_sram

role: AffineNorm/LayerNorm/KAT small parameter or LUT SRAM
physical_sharing: shared over time by nonlinear parameter fetches
mutual_exclusion: exclusive when the same small parameter SRAM/LUT port is reused by concurrent nonlinear ops
pipeline_behavior: typically resident; can prefetch ahead of nonlinear engine execution
note: Covers affine/layernorm gamma-beta and KAT/GRF LUT or coefficient staging

mutual_exclusion: exclusive per operator instance or batch window
